methods.bh_q: Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment over the source report's 24 J-versus-raw/final/MPNet comparisons
methods.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% Student t interval over 8 subject scores (df=7)
methods.delta: paired within-subject J-space minus raw score, then group mean
methods.exact_p: two-sided exhaustive sign-flip test of the mean paired subject delta over all 2^8 sign assignments
methods.mean_correlation: searchlight-center RSA correlations averaged within each sample, then 8 sample means averaged within subject, then 8 subject scores averaged
methods.peak_inference_guardrail: Peaks are descriptive and noise-sensitive; no p or q significance is attached to peak differences. Existing J-versus-raw inference uses whole-searchlight means.
methods.peak_label: peak SEARCHLIGHT-CENTRE RSA correlations, not single-voxel correlations
methods.peak_searchlight_centre: For each subject and feature, first average that subject's eight sample correlation volumes centrewise, restricted to the authoritative valid searchlight centres; a centre with any nonfinite sample value has a nonfinite subject mean and is excluded. Then take the maximum finite centre from that subject-mean map. Across the eight subjects, report mean subject peak, two-sided 95% subject t CI, and observed subject peak range. This avoids selecting a maximum over all 64 sample maps.
